title: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review - prep & notes
content:
Meeting: SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review
Owner: Priya Desai (notes & prep)
Date: 2026-03-03 (prep for sync)
Attendees (planned): Priya, Liam, Maya, Omar, Dev oncall rotation (TBD), Platform Eng rep

Purpose: quick operational check-in focused on SLO status, paging trends, top incidents from last 7-14 days, and prioritized action items for reliability improvements. Keep to 30-40 minutes.

AGENDA (30-40m)
1) Quick status (5m)
   - Roll call / oncall highlights
   - Any blockers for oncall shifts?
2) SLO snapshot & trends (10m)
   - Service-levels to review: Hosted API (generate), Serving runtime RPCs, Tokenization/embeddings pipeline
   - Snapshot (last 7 days):
     * hosted-api/generate availability: 99.92% (target 99.95%) — small dip on Tue 02-Mar during incident SRE-1339
     * runtime/rpc p99 latency: 550ms (target p99 <500ms) — recent upward drift after kernel change on 02-Mar
     * embeddings pipeline success rate: 99.99% (target 99.99) — stable
   - Paging trends: average pages/week last 4 weeks -> 14, 18, 21, 26 (uptrend). Major drivers: noisy upstream job on 02-Mar, misrouted warm-up traffic on 01-Mar

3) Top incidents (10m) — quick summary + current state
   - SRE-1339 (2026-03-02) Hosted API partial outage / increased errors
     * Impact: spike in 5xxs, degraded throughput for ~45m; customer-facing errors for small percentage of requests
     * Root cause (initial): autoscaler bug + kernel change led to warm node flaps -> KV cache thrash -> request errors
     * Mitigation taken: rolled back kernel change (02-Mar 11:40 UTC), increased autoscaler cooldown, applied short-term fallback routing to dedicated pool for high-SLA customers
     * Postmortem status: investigating; assigned to Omar (owner) + infra eng; follow-up RCA doc link SRE-1339
   - SRE-1327 (2026-02-25) Background job storm causing paging noise
     * Impact: elevated paging but not user-facing; delayed background batch job caused resource contention on infra pool
     * Action: scheduled job throttling and safer retry logic deployed (02-Mar). Monitoring to validate.

4) Reliability efforts & proposals (5-8m)
   - Proposal A: tighten p99 latency SLO alert thresholds for runtime/rpc to catch regressions earlier (suggestions: create a 5m rolling alert at 480ms + 15m at 500ms)
   - Proposal B: auto-fallback policy improvements: pre-warm fallback nodes and add small KV cache warming window during rollout
   - Proposal C: deploy improved autoscaler cooldown + circuit-breaker around kernel rollout changes

5) Action items & owners (5-7m)
   - Omar: Complete RCA draft for SRE-1339 and propose a permanent autoscaler fix. Due: 2026-03-06. Linked: SRE-1339.
   - Liam: Add a 5m rolling p99 alert for runtime/rpc and validate alert noise in staging. Due: 2026-03-05. Linked PR: ops-playbooks#48.
   - Maya: Run capacity test with fallback pre-warm config and report perf baseline. Due: 2026-03-09.
   - Priya: Coordinate customer follow-ups for impacted tenants; prepare incident summary for exec ops. Due: 2026-03-04.
   - Platform Eng: Instrument KV cache warm-up metric (metric: kv_cache_warm_ratio). Owner: TBA. Due: 2026-03-10.

NOTES / PREP ITEMS (to capture during meeting)
- Collect exact error budget burn numbers for hosted-api (7d, 30d). Bring dashboard link.
- Verify if rollback thresholds are correctly instrumented in release pipeline (rel-eng).
- Check paging histogram: which teams/pages escalated most (oncall-> pager duty tags).
- Confirm next kernel rollout freeze window until autoscaler fix shipped.

FOLLOW-UPS (post meeting)
- Quick triage doc: convert meeting notes into postmortem skeleton for SRE-1339 (Priya -> assign to Omar)
- Update runbook: add autoscaler cooldown guidance and fallback policy steps (Liam + Platform Eng)
- Oncall schedule tweak: add a "primary reliability contact" for weekend windows next two weeks (Maya to propose)

RISKS & OPEN QUESTIONS
- Risk: autoscaler fix timeline might slip into next sprint; need mitigation (manual capacity + increased warm pool)
- Question: do we want to roll new kernel changes behind a feature flag in runtime to reduce blast radius?
- Question: better telemetry for KV cache thrash metrics — what immediate metrics do we need (cache hit ratio, active kv_writes_per_sec)?

TAGS / QUICK LINKS
- Confluence SLO dashboard: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/SLO+Dashboard
- Incident SRE-1339: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SRE-1339
- Ops playbooks PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-playbooks/pull/48
- Slack thread: #sre-ops (thread ID: C02ABCD1234)

NEXT MEETING: 2026-03-10 (tentative)

Quick personal notes (scratchpad):
- Keep meeting short; focus on actions + owners
- If SRE-1339 RCA not ready, push RCA sync with infra owners next Tue
- Prepare 1 slide of SLO burn & incident highlights for TGIF ops update

--- End of notes ---
